key_idea: The recurrence a_n = (a_{n-1}+a_{n-2})/2 converges geometrically (ratio -1/2) to 1/3 potato, 2/3 tomato, so simulating min(n, ~200) days is exact to double precision.
sketch: Iterate the potato share starting from 100, 0 for min(n,200) steps and print it with its complement to 100. O(1). Pitfall: n is up to 1e18 so read it as 64-bit and do not loop n times; a closed form with (-1/2)^n also works.
